text: Jen - dad passed Sat, v sudden, heart. funeral end of the month @ St Mary's, then wake at her aunt's. her brother Owen flying in from Toronto the day before. she's holding it together for her mum but sounded wrecked on the phone. send card this wk + ask if she needs anything the week after - meals, lifts, whatever
Yusuf made redundant @ Barclays, told Fri. says he's fine but v quiet. check in sometime next week
Aoife & Owen split up. she's kept the flat, he's back at his mum's

Vikram's boss (Delroy) off sick again, 3rd time this month - Vikram covering the Hughes client pitch Thurs on his own. nervous re presenting, hasn't done one this big. also his wife Gemma's due any day so he's barely sleeping. text him good luck that morning + offer to run through slides Weds eve
Mila - new manager starts early March. hates restructures. thinks her team's next
Delroy = big Arsenal fan, season ticket w/ his brother Reza
Chiara's nonna died last wk. flying to Bologna for funeral Tues, back the weekend after. nursery pickup cover for her kids?? offered
bins out Weds. dentist sometime next week - book
Rohan - wedding's off. he & Tanvi broke up end of summer, only just told me. go for a pint w/ him soon
Isabel (Izzy) - interview @ Deloitte Mon. ask how it went the next day
Gemma's mum - hip op 3rd Nov. G driving her in that morning + staying over the night after. ring G afterwards
Hoang - leaving drinks Fri for Akira (moving to Tokyo office). I'm doing the card + collection
Magda Kowalski, new client @ Nowak & Sons. coeliac - no pastries @ next mtg

Eduardo struggling since the divorce went through. kids w/ him alt weekends, the rest w/ his ex in Reading. his sister Adriana moved in to help over the summer but she's heading back to Porto early Nov. he said work's the only thing keeping him going. his boss knows, being decent about it
Julien & Demi - 10th anniv mid-Dec, thinking Paris. Demi dropping hints about a Polaroid camera
call Teresa re her dog Biscuit - op went ok? vet was Tues
Owen's grandad's funeral Thurs 11am. Owen asked me to do a reading - nervous. practise the night before
Jess - redundancy consultation mtg w/ HR sometime next week. stressed, mortgage just renewed. msg her the day before + after
team lunch moved to end of the month. Rahul organising, he's veggie
Zainab - started @ Unilever Mon, marketing. ask how 1st wk went
Mia's dad Reza retiring after 30 yrs @ Royal Mail - do on the 14th. she wants a surprise. chip in for gift
Irina = Ilse's sister. Ilse's moving to Berlin early March, Irina gutted. both coming to Hannah's bday Sat

Alejandro - lost the Barros contract. Mr Barros pulled out last min, boss blamed him in front of the client + the whole team. not ok, kept saying he'd be next on the list. his partner Mia thinks he should go to HR. coffee w/ him Mon? and maybe sometime next week ask if he wants a hand w/ his CV
Ava's cat Pickle went missing Sun. posters up. she's beside herself
Tanvi Morris - PhD viva early Feb. terrified. her partner Owen says she's not sleeping. card + good luck msg the day before
Hughes account review pushed to sometime next week. Vikram presenting, I'm doing slides
Akira's mum - diagnosis appt Weds. he's going w/ her. don't forget to text him that evening
Delroy & his wife Hannah expecting #2, due early April. their eldest starts reception in Sept too
met Jen's new bf Yusuf. nice. works in IT, into climbing
Gemma - 40th next month. wants a decent espresso machine (hinted twice)
Rahul - flat viewing Sat, Hackney. if he gets it moving end of Nov. ask how it went
Adriana Barros, client. merger announced, half her dept going. she's job hunting quietly

Mila and her husband split - separated since the summer. he's moved to Leeds for work, sees the kids every other weekend. she's ok-ish, says it's for the best, but kids struggling more, the eldest especially - school rang twice. her mum Teresa staying w/ them till Xmas to help. invite them all round sometime next week, kids can play w/ ours
Demi - driving test Fri am, 3rd attempt. text her good luck the night before, then ask how it went afterwards
Owen got the promotion!! team lead from Jan. send congrats
Chiara back from Bologna. funeral was hard, her brother Julien didn't make it. ring her at the weekend
Eduardo's boss = Ilse Dubois. tough but fair apparently
me - haircut Thurs, then gym. pick up dry cleaning before Sat
Ilse - Berlin move delayed till end of March, visa thing. leaving do still on for the 28th
Aoife - fine about Owen now apparently. new job @ Google from Mon, buzzing. ask how first day went
Magda's husband died in Aug, she mentioned it at end of call. 1st anniv of his death will be next Aug - note it. keep things light
Hannah - bday 2nd Dec. loves gin + anything Studio Ghibli
Vikram & Gemma - housewarming Sat 8th, new place in Bristol. I'm bringing dessert
Isabel got the Deloitte job! starts early Jan. she's nervous about leaving her team. card from all of us

Jess - consult mtg went badly, role's going end of the month. 6 wks pay + they'll keep her on till the 30th. she's ok, has savings, already chatting to a recruiter. her partner Rohan being great, took her away the weekend after. check in a week after her last day - she'll probably feel it more then
Reza's daughter Mia - graduating in July, law @ Durham. he's v proud
Rahul's grandma passed. funeral Sat, Leicester. his cousin Hoang driving them up the day before. send flowers to the house
Julien - knee op cancelled, rescheduled to sometime in Jan. still on crutches. annoyed
Teresa's son Alejandro - getting married over the summer, Seville. she's anxious about the flight
Zainab mentioned her manager Akira's leaving - they're all worried who replaces him. she might apply

client dinner w/ Hughes team next Thurs @ Hawksmoor. Ava hosting, first time, nervous about it - Mr Hughes is famously fussy and his wife's vegan. Ava's manager Zainab can't make it. help her w/ seating plan the day before + maybe call the restaurant re menu
Irina - breakup w/ Julien was 2 wks ago. not eating properly, staying w/ her sister Ilse. take her for a walk at the weekend
Yusuf - interviews lined up early Nov, two of them. confident tbh. asked me for a reference - must send by Fri
gran's headstone going up end of the month. me & Dad going. book train
Demi passed!! 3rd time lucky
Hoang's dog Mochi put to sleep Mon. he's gutted, had him 14 yrs
Mia - new boss, micromanager. she's looking around, wants something in publishing by the summer

Aoife's brother Delroy back from Australia for xmas, then staying till early Feb - first time home in 4 yrs. she's throwing a welcome home thing the Sat after he lands, at their mum's. Delroy's gf Ilse coming too, not met her yet. Aoife asked if I'd do a playlist
Adriana - last day Fri after 12 yrs. leaving lunch, I'm going. she's sad but has a new role lined up from mid-Nov. ask how the new place is a week after she starts

Tanvi said Rohan's mum is unwell again, back in hospital. Rohan going up north to see her this weekend, and his brother Vikram is flying back from Dubai the day after. Rohan sounded shattered. Need to check in w/ him once he's back, maybe drop food round
